h1: Glow-in-the-Dark Cups for Branded Night Events
lead: Compare glow-in-the-dark cup models and their listed materials before selecting your event artwork. Keep glow-body effects distinct from LED-powered lighting and color-changing ink.
html:
Three effects are different product choices

A glow-body effect, an electronic light and a temperature-responsive color change use different product configurations. Choose the effect you want before fixing the cup and logo layout.

Review the physical appearance

Use a physical product reference to review the effect in the intended setting. A visual mockup shows the branding concept; it is not evidence of a universal brightness or duration rating.
